La respuesta a «¿en qué puesto acabo?» e: The answer to “where will I finish?” is a distribution. The rest of the season is simulated thousands of times: each pending match is played with random goals based on each team's attack and defence strength, and where each finishes is counted. Strength is shrunk towards the league average with K = 5 so as not to trust few matches, and the home team gets a 1.20 advantage on its expected goals.

A score says who won, not why. “We got there nine times and scored once” and “we got there three times and scored twice” are the same 1-2 and call for opposite decisions: the first a forward, the second midfield. That's why the screen separates chance creation (midfield and tactic) from finishing (scoring and luck).
Un partido de Hattrick es un conjunto de: A Hattrick match is a set of localised duels. If you measure what share of each duel each team takes and know how much each weighs, you can estimate how many goals each side will score, and from that the probability of each score and each result. The weights come from two regressions fitted on 5,232 real league matches from 979 teams in five countries.

Una alerta se puede archivar. Al hacerlo: An alert can be archived. Doing so stores a fingerprint of its content (severity, title, detail and action). If the situation changes, for example from “you lose 300,000 per week” to “you lose 900,000”, the fingerprint no longer matches and the alert returns to the active list on its own: archiving doesn't silence a problem that gets worse. From the inbox you can bring back any archived alert.

Una fila por cada jugador vendido o desp: One row per sold or fired player: what they cost, what they earned, what they sold for, the commissions and the ROI. “?” is unknown data, never a zero.
Una herramienta de análisis para manager: An analysis tool for Hattrick managers: it reads your club's data and turns it into answers with their reasons.
A measurement is data Hattrick provided. An estimate is a calculation with a margin of error (an old wage, a forecast). A scenario is a projection that depends on assumptions (cash without trading). The app never presents an estimate or a scenario as a measurement.
Una regresión de Poisson (la herramienta: A Poisson regression (the standard tool for counting goals) estimates λ, each side's expected goals, as two terms. Open play depends on the midfield duel and the average of the three attack lanes (30 % each wing and 40 % the centre, with a common exponent of 3.39, so the best lane dominates). Set pieces are separate, with a dependence on midfield three times smaller. On average, 72 % of expected goals come from open play and 28 % from set pieces.
Una regresión ordinal aprende directamen: An ordinal regression learns directly from who won, with the nine duels (including defensive ones). The two models err in different places, so they're blended: 80 % the goals model and 20 % the result model. 80 % is the minimum error and the last point where the draw is still calibrated.
Una temporada de Hattrick dura 16 semana: A Hattrick season lasts 16 weeks and a year of a player's age is 112 days. The game's calendar runs on Swedish time: Hattrick's “today” changes before yours if you live west of Europe.
